title: CISA: Elecbrakes trailer brake controllers have Bluetooth flaws; no fix for ELBC2000
summary: CISA's advisory ICSA-26-323-02, released 19 November 2026, covers three flaws in Elecbrakes EB2, VM1 and ELBC2000 trailer brake controllers, including unauthenticated command injection by a nearby Bluetooth Low Energy device. CISA says exploitation could let an attacker take control of trailer brakes or modify firmware. Fixed firmware exists for EB2 and VM1; ELBC2000, a discontinued model, has no fix. CISA reports no known public exploitation.
plain: CISA warns that a nearby attacker could take control of trailer brakes on some Elecbrakes controllers. Fixed firmware exists for two models; a discontinued third has no fix. CISA reports no known public exploitation.
exec: Fleets and owners using Elecbrakes controllers face a brake-control risk, per CISA. Two models have fixed firmware; ELBC2000 has none.
action: CISA advises updating EB2 to firmware 3.0.4.4.3 and VM1 to 1.3.4.2.1 through the Elecbrakes app; no fix exists for ELBC2000.

validation.note: CISA's own advisory read. The Tom's Hardware article on the same flaws returned no body text, so it is not cited.
